title: Brot in Deutschland
titleTranslation: Bread in Germany
summary: This article describes Germany's rich bread culture, from the many varieties bakers make fresh daily to how bread is eaten at breakfast and dinner.

title: Ein Tag im Sento
titleTranslation: A Day at the Sento
summary: This article explains what a sento is and describes the etiquette and social experience of visiting a traditional Japanese public bathhouse.

title: 駅弁の楽しみ
titleTranslation: The Joy of Ekiben (Station Lunch Boxes)
summary: The article explains what ekiben (station lunch boxes) are, their long history, regional variety, and the enjoyment of choosing and eating them while traveling by train in Japan.

title: 銭湯に行ってみましょう
titleTranslation: Let's Go to a Sento (Public Bath)
summary: The article introduces Japanese public bathhouses called sento, covering their history, bathing rules, features, and the social role they play for local communities.

title: コンビニのおにぎり
titleTranslation: Convenience Store Rice Balls
summary: The article explains what onigiri (Japanese rice balls) are, how they are eaten, and why they are popular and convenient in Japanese daily life.

title: 日本の「はんこ」
titleTranslation: Japan's "Hanko" (Personal Seal)
summary: The article explains what a hanko (personal name stamp) is, how and when Japanese people use it in daily life, and how it is gradually being supplemented by signatures.

title: 日本の自動販売機
titleTranslation: Japan's Vending Machines
summary: This article explains that Japan has an unusually large number of vending machines, which are conveniently available everywhere and at all hours, offering both hot and cold drinks with cash or electronic payment.

title: 文部科学省が科研費を2倍にしたいです
titleTranslation: The Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology wants to double science research grants
summary: Japan's education ministry plans to double the Kaken-hi science research grant to a record 455.2 billion yen and convert it into a multi-year fund, backed by Prime Minister Takaichi's push to strengthen basic research and Keidanren's request to reverse Japan's declining scientific competitiveness.

title: 折り紙のはなし
titleTranslation: The Story of Origami
summary: This article introduces origami, Japan's traditional paper-folding play, explaining how it is done, its most famous form (the crane), and its popularity both in Japan and abroad.

title: 台風20号で今日大雨の危険台風18号は26日に沖縄へ
titleTranslation: Danger of Heavy Rain Today from Typhoon No. 20; Typhoon No. 18 to Reach Okinawa on the 26th
summary: Three typhoons are active near Japan, with Typhoon No. 20 bringing dangerously heavy rain to the Sakishima Islands today while Typhoon No. 18 strengthens and is expected to reach Okinawa with destructive winds and high waves around the 25th-27th.

title: 自民党、沖縄の選挙に勝ちたいえらい人たちが沖縄へ
titleTranslation: The LDP wants to win Okinawa's election — top officials head to Okinawa
summary: Ahead of Okinawa's gubernatorial election, the LDP is sending its senior officials to campaign for candidate Genta Koja in hopes of retaking the governorship after 12 years, while downplaying its party image to attract broader support.

title: 日本へ来る前に知っておきたい日本の食事のマナー 7つ
titleTranslation: 7 Japanese Dining Manners You Should Know Before Coming to Japan
summary: The article introduces seven Japanese dining etiquette points for visitors to know before eating at restaurants in Japan, covering oshibori use, the itadakimasu/gochisousama greetings, chopstick etiquette, holding bowls, keeping elbows off the table, slurping noodles and soup, and finishing everything you order.

title: 【能登半島地震 】日本へ旅行に来た・日本に住んでいる外国人への災害情報まとめ
titleTranslation: [Noto Peninsula Earthquake] A Roundup of Disaster Information for Foreigners Visiting or Living in Japan
summary: This article compiles reliable, multilingual sources of information—such as NHK World Japan, the Safety Tips app, prefectural and city websites, and embassy phone numbers—to help foreign visitors and residents in Japan stay informed about the January 2024 Noto Peninsula earthquake and its damage.

title: 東京・茨城・埼玉・千葉で地震 37人がけが
titleTranslation: Earthquake hits Tokyo, Ibaraki, Saitama, and Chiba — 37 injured
summary: A magnitude earthquake registering upper 5 on the Japanese intensity scale struck the Tokyo, Ibaraki, Saitama, and Chiba region early on the 23rd, injuring 37 people, causing water leaks and a false fire alarm, and briefly halting train service.

title: やさしい日本語の音声がダウンロードできる「聴く MATCHA やさしい日本語」が始まりました！
titleTranslation: The "Listen to MATCHA Easy Japanese" service, where you can download audio of easy Japanese, has launched!
summary: MATCHA's Easy Japanese edition now offers downloadable audio of native Japanese staff reading select articles, letting learners practice natural pronunciation anytime, with some recordings free and others costing 100 yen.

title: 【大分県 】由布院温泉 〜行き方・日帰り温泉・オススメの旅館など〜
titleTranslation: 【Oita Prefecture】 Yufuin Onsen — How to Get There, Day-Trip Hot Springs, Recommended Inns
summary: This article introduces Yufuin Onsen in Oita Prefecture, covering its health benefits, how to get there from Tokyo and Osaka, recommended day-trip baths and inns, and nearby sightseeing spots.

title: コスパがいいべんりな日本のオススメビジネスホテルチェーン TOP5
titleTranslation: Good Value for Money: 5 Recommended Business Hotel Chains in Japan
summary: The article introduces five popular Japanese business hotel chains (Toyoko Inn, APA Hotel, Dormy Inn, Super Hotel, and Route Inn), describing their prices, room types, and convenient services for travelers.

title: 【2024年 】京都でオススメのあじさいスポット 10選！
titleTranslation: [2024] 10 Recommended Hydrangea Spots in Kyoto!
summary: A guide to ten recommended hydrangea-viewing spots in and around Kyoto, covering temples, shrines, and a nature park, along with their blooming seasons, access information, and nearby hydrangea-themed cafes.

title: 京都・嵐山のオススメの 5つのカフェ！渡月橋を見ながらコーヒーを楽しもう
titleTranslation: 5 Recommended Cafes in Arashiyama, Kyoto! Enjoy Coffee While Looking at Togetsukyo Bridge
summary: The article introduces five recommended cafes near Arashiyama, Kyoto, describing each shop's history, specialty food and drink, and atmosphere for visitors near Togetsukyo Bridge and the Bamboo Grove Path.

title: 日本で使えるべんりなタクシーのアプリ 6つ～使いかた、ことば、お金のはらいかた～
titleTranslation: 6 Convenient Taxi Apps You Can Use in Japan – How to Use Them, Language, and Payment Methods
summary: The article introduces six convenient taxi-calling apps usable in Japan, explaining how to register, communicate, and pay for each service.

title: Polizeiminister in Israel - Zentralrat der Juden kritisiert Aufruf zu gezielten Tötungen
titleTranslation: Police Minister in Israel - Central Council of Jews Criticizes Call for Targeted Killings
summary: Israel's far-right police and security minister Itamar Ben-Gvir has sparked widespread criticism, including from Germany's Central Council of Jews, after calling for 30 to 40 people to be deliberately killed in Gaza every night.

title: Digitale Angebote - Behinderten-Beauftragter findet Gesetz für Barriere-Freiheit nicht gut genug
titleTranslation: Digital Services - Disability Commissioner Says Accessibility Law Isn't Good Enough
summary: Germany's disability commissioner, Jürgen Dusel, argues that the country's new law requiring digital accessibility doesn't go far enough, since it excludes many apps and carries no penalties for violations.

title: Wald-Brände - In einigen Regionen in Deutschland riecht es nach Feuer
titleTranslation: Forest fires - In some regions of Germany it smells like fire
summary: Large wildfires in Belgium and elsewhere are sending smoke smell and fine dust into German cities like Cologne and Bonn, prompting doctor warnings, though rain is expected to bring relief this week.

title: Partei Jabloko - Russischer Politiker muss wegen Kritik an dem Krieg in der Ukraine in ein Straf-Lager
titleTranslation: Yabloko Party - Russian politician must go to a penal colony over criticism of the war in Ukraine
summary: The article gives simplified background on Ukraine's geography, language, and its history of conflict with Russia, including the 2022 invasion.

title: Krankheit - Fußball-Spieler Jamal Musiala erklärt seine Ohnmachts-Anfälle
titleTranslation: Illness - Football player Jamal Musiala explains his fainting spells
summary: German football star Jamal Musiala revealed he has a neurological condition that causes brief fainting spells but says it is not dangerous and he can keep playing.

title: Krieg gegen die Ukraine - Viele Tote bei Raketen-Angriff auf Stadt Kiew
titleTranslation: War against Ukraine - Many dead in missile attack on the city of Kyiv
summary: Russia launched a renewed missile attack on Kyiv killing at least 16 people, while Ukraine struggles to defend itself against fast Russian missiles due to a shortage of costly Patriot interceptor missiles.

title: Den Haag - Die USA verhängen Strafen gegen wichtiges internationales Gericht
titleTranslation: The Hague - The USA imposes sanctions on important international court
summary: The article explains the difference between the International Criminal Court, which prosecutes war crimes and crimes against humanity, and the International Court of Justice, which settles disputes between states under the United Nations.

title: Klima-Wandel - In Deutschland gibt es immer mehr Gottes-Anbeterinnen
titleTranslation: Climate change - There are more and more praying mantises in Germany
summary: Climate change is making Germany warmer, allowing praying mantises to spread from southern Europe and Africa into new regions, with a record 17,000 reported this year, mostly along the Rhine and in eastern Germany, and the article explains they pose no danger to humans.

title: Gegen Gewalt - Behinderten-Beauftragter fordert mehr Schutz für Frauen in Wohn-Gruppen
titleTranslation: Against Violence - Disability Commissioner Calls for More Protection for Women in Residential Groups
summary: Germany's federal disability commissioner Jürgen Dusel is calling for a mandatory women's representative in every residential group home, after a study found that half of women with disabilities have experienced physical violence and one in five has experienced sexual violence.

title: Neue Zahlen - Deutsche Firmen verkaufen wieder mehr Waren im Ausland
titleTranslation: New figures - German companies selling more goods abroad again
summary: The article explains what tariffs are and why governments impose them, framed by news that German companies are exporting more goods again.

title: "Redaktion andererseits" - Instagram-Kanal bekommt Preis für inklusive Themen
titleTranslation: "Editorial on the Other Hand" — Instagram Channel Receives Award for Inclusive Topics
summary: This article explains what Instagram is: an app where people create pages, share photos and videos, and view content from others, owned by Meta and popular among young people.

title: Pokal-Wettbewerb - DFB untersucht Streit im Spiel zwischen Mannheim und Kaiserslautern
titleTranslation: Cup Competition - DFB investigates dispute in match between Mannheim and Kaiserslautern
summary: After a violent altercation and injuries at a DFB Cup match between SV Waldhof Mannheim and 1. FC Kaiserslautern, the German Football Association is investigating the incident and considering possible penalties.

title: West-Jordan-Land - Deutschland ruft Israel auf, keine neuen Siedlungen zu bauen
titleTranslation: West Bank - Germany calls on Israel to build no new settlements
summary: The article explains who the Palestinians are, the divided control over the West Bank and Gaza Strip between Palestinians and Israel, and the historical roots of the ongoing conflict.

title: Fluss - Mehr Wasser im Rhein: Einige Fähren können wieder fahren
titleTranslation: River: More water in the Rhine — some ferries can run again
summary: After a long dry spell lowered the Rhine's water level and halted several ferries for weeks, recent rainfall has raised the river enough for most ferries to resume operation, though large or heavy vehicles still face restrictions.

title: 国民民主代表選が告示橋本、玉木氏の一騎打ち
titleTranslation: DPFP Leadership Election Announced: Hashimoto and Tamaki in Head-to-Head Race
summary: The Democratic Party for the People announced its leadership election with incumbent Yuichiro Tamaki facing challenger Mikihiko Hashimoto, who clashed over party direction and coalition politics ahead of the September 6 vote.

title: 高市外交に「弱腰」批判 ICC、ロシア対応巡り
titleTranslation: Takaichi diplomacy criticized as 'weak-kneed' over ICC, Russia response
summary: The Takaichi administration is facing domestic criticism for its timid response to U.S. sanctions on ICC President Akane Tomoko and to Putin's visit to the Northern Territories, largely out of concern for relations with the U.S. and Japan's energy supply from Russia.

title: Krieg in der Ukraine - Der deutsche Außenminister besucht Kiew und sichert Hilfe zu
titleTranslation: War in Ukraine - The German Foreign Minister visits Kyiv and pledges help
summary: The article gives background on Ukraine's geography, language, and history with Russia, explaining the roots of the war that forms the context for the German foreign minister's visit to Kyiv.

title: 乃木坂46 落雷の影響で一時避難した観客の入場前に公演開始を謝罪スタッフ間で状況共有されず
titleTranslation: Nogizaka46 apologizes for starting show before audience members who evacuated due to lightning had finished re-entering; situation not shared among staff
summary: Idol group Nogizaka46 apologized after starting a Tokyo concert while some fans who had evacuated due to lightning danger had not yet finished re-entering the venue, blaming a lack of communication among staff.

title: 【怒り】「女に生まれて損や！」国も動きだした“女性トイレ行列問題” 長蛇の列を劇的に解消した『次世代トイレ』の驚愕システムとは
titleTranslation: [Anger] "Being born a woman is a loss!" The government finally moves on the "women's restroom line problem" — the astonishing system of the "next-generation toilet" that dramatically ended the long lines (Yomiuri TV)
summary: The article examines why women face much longer restroom lines than men in Japan, and covers Japan's new government guidelines plus overseas laws and next-generation toilet designs aimed at fixing the imbalance.

title: オオカミの群れと暮らしていた「シエラモレナの狼少年」、80歳で死去スペイン
titleTranslation: The 'Wolf Boy of Sierra Morena,' who lived with a wolf pack, dies at 80 in Spain
summary: A Spanish man known as the 'Wolf Boy of Sierra Morena,' who was abandoned as a child and spent 12 years living in the wild with a pack of wolves before eventually returning to human society, has died at age 80.

title: 「9歳のとき急に体を触られ…」父親から性的虐待 15歳で妊娠、中絶も「信じてもらえなかった」当事者が語る“密室の家庭”とSOSが届かない構造
titleTranslation: "At age 9, he suddenly started touching my body..." Sexually abused by her father, pregnant at 15, had an abortion, "nobody believed me" — a survivor speaks out on the "locked-room household" and the structure that keeps SOS signals from getting through
summary: A woman called Kana describes years of sexual and physical abuse by her alcoholic father starting at age nine, a pregnancy and abortion at fifteen, repeated self-harm, and being disbelieved by school, child welfare, and police, illustrating how sexual abuse within families in Japan stays hidden and hard for victims' SOS signals to reach help.

title: 「お金を取られた」介護現場でケアマネらが直面するトラブル、殺人事件で浮き彫りに
titleTranslation: "They Took My Money" — The Troubles Care Managers Face in Long-Term Care, Brought Into Sharp Relief by a Murder Case
summary: The June murder of a care manager in Kawaguchi, Saitama has exposed the customer harassment and safety risks facing Japan's long-term care workers, prompting new mandatory anti-harassment measures and government subsidies for accompanied home visits.

title: 富士山や北海道の紅葉も！日本の 8つの紅葉ツアー
titleTranslation: Autumn Leaves at Mt. Fuji and Hokkaido Too! 8 Autumn Foliage Tours in Japan
summary: The article introduces eight day-trip bus tours across Japan — from Hokkaido and Tohoku to the Mt. Fuji area, greater Tokyo, and Fukuoka — for enjoying autumn foliage together with local nature, food, and cultural sites.

title: 衆院比例に「サンラグ式」新案が浮上…小政党取り込む野党懐柔策か提案元は「みらい」
titleTranslation: New 'Sainte-Laguë method' proposal emerges for House of Representatives proportional seats... a ploy to win over minor parties and soften opposition? Proposal originated from 'Team Mirai'
summary: Japan's ruling party is considering adopting the Sainte-Laguë method for allocating House of Representatives proportional seats instead of the current D'Hondt method, a change that would favor smaller parties and appears aimed at easing opposition resistance to a planned cut in proportional seats.

title: 東京駅近くで道路に穴掘削現場に水流れ込む関東南部で豪雨
titleTranslation: Hole opens in road near Tokyo Station, water flows into excavation site as heavy rain hits southern Kanto
summary: Torrential rain in southern Kanto on the afternoon of the 22nd triggered flood warnings, a flooded road that stranded a car, and a road cave-in near Tokyo Station, though no injuries were reported.

title: 太宰府天満宮・博多ラーメンなど福岡を 2日で楽しむルート
titleTranslation: Dazaifu Tenmangu, Hakata Ramen, and More: A Route to Enjoy Fukuoka in 2 Days
summary: This easy-Japanese travel guide from MATCHA lays out a one-night, two-day route for enjoying Fukuoka, covering shopping in Tenjin, ramen at Ichiran, Seaside Momochi Park and Fukuoka Tower, Nakasu's food stalls, Don Quijote, Ohori Park, Dazaifu Tenmangu shrine, and shopping at Hakata JR City before flying out.

title: 「スペーシアX」は現場200メートル手前で警笛東武鉄道の記録装置で判明除草作業員4人死亡事故
titleTranslation: 'Spacia X' Sounded Horn 200 Meters Before the Site — Tobu Railway's Recorder Reveals — Accident Kills 4 Weed-Clearing Workers
summary: A Tobu Railway recording device shows the express train "Spacia X" sounded its horn 200 meters before hitting and killing four weed-clearing workers in Kanuma, Tochigi Prefecture, and police are now investigating the safety-check procedures used at the time.

title: JR渋谷駅のホームから改札 (ハチ公・中央・南・新南)へのアクセス
titleTranslation: Access from the JR Shibuya Station Platforms to the Ticket Gates
summary: The article explains, in easy Japanese, how to get from the platforms of JR Shibuya Station to its four ticket gates (Hachiko, Central, South, and New South), including nearby shops, restaurants, and train transfer routes at each one.

title: おなかに良いだけではない！日本の乳酸菌飲料「ヤクルト」の秘密を教えます
titleTranslation: It's not just good for your stomach! We'll teach you the secrets of Japan's lactic acid bacteria drink 'Yakult'
summary: This article introduces the history of Japan's beloved probiotic drink Yakult, from its founder's discovery of the resilient 'Shirota strain' bacteria to the design story behind its iconic container, its product lineup, and the door-to-door 'Yakult Lady' sales tradition.

title: 3日間で 300万人が訪れる人気のお寺・神奈川「川崎大師」
titleTranslation: Kawasaki Daishi, Kanagawa: The Popular Temple Visited by 3 Million People in 3 Days
summary: This article introduces Kawasaki Daishi, a historic temple in Kanagawa Prefecture founded in 1128 that enshrines the monk Kobo Daishi Kukai and draws about 3 million visitors over the New Year holiday, describing its main hall, octagonal pagoda, ponds, bridges, and Yakushi Hall.
